title_as_printed: Observed Densities as a Function of Temperature

footnotes_as_printed.a: Calculated by least squares from the data given at higher temperatures. These values are adjusted (Table II) to make the densities at 25 C agree with those previously determined (3).

pressure_note: not stated; dilatometer capillary end enclosed in a box 'in which the pressure is kept constant in order to prevent errors due to pressure changes'; no pressure value printed

value2.what: density of pure water at 0 C minus density at t, observed (d0 here is the adjusted constant)

composition.other_species: Li2SO4 and LiCl are present in 8 of the 13 blocks (Li2SO4, LiCl and their mixtures with each other, NaCl or Na2SO4); the blocks are Na2SO4, Li2SO4, NaCl, LiCl (pure, ionic strength 4.000) and 9 mixtures at ionic strength 4.000 given by equivalent fraction of the first salt. Pure-salt molalities are set per block (1.333_4 m for the sulphates, 4.000_0 and 3.999_8 m for the chlorides). Ionic strength mu = 4.000 mol per kg water (Nomenclature) for all blocks; recorded here only.

volume_basis_evidence: density in g/mL of the solution

skip_rows.reason: t = 0 C density is a least-squares extrapolation adjusted to 25 C densities (footnote a), not measured

extra_unmapped: Ad x 10^6 (d_obsd - d_calcd, residual of the least-squares fit)
conversion_needs: mixture molalities are not printed; they are derived from mu = 4.000 and the equivalent fraction E (not an ionic-strength fraction; p = 2 for sulfates): sulfate+chloride m_S = 4E/(2+E), m_C = 4 - 3 m_S; Li2SO4+Na2SO4 m1 = 4E/3, m2 = 4(1-E)/3. Verified by the auditor against Table III Young-rule means (p.230)
notes: Temperatures are printed with the last digit as a subscript (e.g. 5.12 with subscript 2); written here as a full number 5.122. Each block has 1 or 2 series of runs (two Na2SO4, Li2SO4, NaCl and LiCl series are replicate fillings). Pure-salt block labels print m with a subscript last digit (written 1.3334 etc.). Block labels in the CSV are normalised ASCII (E_Li2SO4 etc.). Table II, III (constants), Table V (cross-square rule) not extracted. Mixture blocks are mapped as the two derived salt molalities (see conversion_needs); Li-containing blocks are outside the six-ion set and are held by the builder.
caution: Densities were adjusted to match the authors' earlier 25 C values (ref 3): 'The determined densities were, therefore, adjusted to match the values at 25 C given by the equations in reference (3)' (p.227); not independent of ref 3. Absolute reliability +-3e-5 g/mL.
